research.topic: Run 08 — all 521 ticker fragments and renderer
research.conclusion: Fetched production corpus; exact parsed match to repository: 521 fragments, seven catalog sources, no unresolved sourceIds. All entries have text/tone/status/category/sourceIds but no per-item dates or Lions canonical publication IDs. Renderer extracts only text/tone, discarding source/status context. Inventory records each row and missing fields. This is structural/source-mapping inspection, not current factual re-verification of all 521 entries. Currentness, latest assessment and full claim-to-source entailment remain incomplete.

vetoes.candidate: Treating recurring LIVE/NARRATIVE SPIKE/DETECTED labels as current monitoring results
vetoes.reason: Static corpus and deterministic sampled rendering provide no per-item observation timestamp or current monitoring evidence. Repetition does not establish a new event or current trend. Cannot rewrite ticker via whole-site-update-v2.
vetoes.replacement: Attach dated claim context and an evidence state where supported; record static implementation requirements instead of creating hundreds of low-value companion articles.

siteRecommendations: RUN 08 BLOCKED: public/matrix/matrix-fragments.en.json and ScanBackdrop must expose each real-world claim’s source, source date, observation date, canonical Lions record where available and precise evidence state. Renderer currently uses only text/tone. Acceptance: a reader can reach meaningful dated context for every displayed real claim; historical examples do not imply live monitoring; complex propositions are not reduced to a binary color. Neutral visual terms need no fabricated claim record.

RUN 08 INCOMPLETE RESEARCH: The per-row audit covers all 521 corpus entries and source-ID integrity, but does not establish latest factual assessment of every item. Seven broad catalog references are not sufficient proof of each proposition. Complete claim-level entailment and currentness before presenting the stream as a verified/live source. No ticker code, CSS or schema changed.
